name: inula2-rust-compiler
description: Rust implementation of Inula 2.0 compiler with NAPI, WASM, and Node.js support

scripts.build:wasm: cd src/wasm && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg
scripts.build:all: npm run build:napi && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:nodejs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:performance
scripts.docs: npm run docs:api && npm run docs:guides

author: Inula Team
